# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_STRUCTURE_RETEST_AFTER_COMPRESSION

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After a midday volatility contraction (10:30-10:50), a breakout of the narrow range often gets tested, offering a mean-reversion bounce from the breakout level. We enter a counter-trade on the first retest of the breakout level, provided the 9-EMA and 21-EMA are flat and volume on the retest bar is below average.

## Mechanism
1. Identify a 20-min window (10:30-10:50) where ATR(5) < 0.3× its 20-period average (volatility compression).
2. Wait for price to break the window’s highest high or lowest low by ≥0.1% (breakout).
3. Enter a counter-trade on the first retest of the breakout level (price within 0.05% of that level) with a limit order, provided the 9-EMA and 21-EMA are flat (|slope| < 0.001) and volume on the retest bar is < average volume.
4. Exit: Stop beyond the opposite side of the compression window (e.g., if long after low breakout, stop at window low); target 1R; if price reaches 0.5R, move stop to break-even; runner trails using a 15% trailing stop from highest close.
